diagnosis: The custom WASM query execution endpoint compiles user-supplied WebAssembly blobs and binds a host import (read_vault_record) that queries secure_data_vaults based on targetVaultId. The endpoint never verifies whether targetVaultId belongs to req.user.tenant_id. An attacker can execute WASM modules that read confidential vault metrics and encrypted keys of other tenants.
